comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: If you use x1 Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers for Job Endorsement, the NPC named Molina (Spanish flag NPC; three trading caravels) sailing around Naples gives this job card. It can be easier to do than the quest if you're in a hurry. Hope this helps. Cheers.

comments.author: mecha
comments.body: As Guilder mentioned above, the endorsement can also be obtained from an NPC named De La Leina (porto flag NPC; three trading ships) sailing around naples.
